proposition: In Nafsat I Ibn Turka argues that even if he had had Sufi leanings, which he denies, true Sufis exemplify the Sunna; he cites Anṣārī, al-Tirmidhī, Ḥamuvayī and above all Muḥammad Pārsā, and separates them from charlatans who gather disciples and rulers or chant that everything is God, a barb MK says is clearly aimed at Fażl Allāh's followers among others.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur I (829/1426, to Shahrukh's court)
mediation.note: written to the court that was judging him; MK: produced under duress, treat with caution (pdf p.32 fn 44)
the barb's target is MK's inference
